name: Take a Break Ohio State 2023

venue.name: [Ohio Union](https://ohiounion.osu.edu)
venue.details: Friday: Student-Alumni Council Room (2nd Floor), Saturday: Ohio Staters, Inc. Traditions Room (2nd Floor)

information: This competition is on a Friday evening and Saturday, and will only feature Side Events and Blind Events. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). **Friday, March 17th - Student-Alumni Council Room** *FMC (Fewest Moves Challenge)* **Saturday, March 18th - Ohio Staters, Inc. Traditions Room** *6x6 7x7 Square-1 Clock 3BLD 4BLD 5BLD 3x3 Multi-Blind*
